desc:
⭐🧗 Welcome to Parkour Tower!

Can you reach the top? Test your skills in the ultimate climbing challenge! Use your parkour skills to beat the tower and become a parkour master!

HOW TO PLAY:
- 🚀 Use your parkour skills to reach new heights!
- 🤾‍♂️ DON'T FALL! If you slip, you might fall to the bottom!
- 💸 Buy GLOVES to increase your speed and jump height!
- 🌍 Reach the top to unlock more worlds!

SKILLS:
🏃 Wall Run & Wall Kick to go higher!
✨ Double Jump & Vault over obstacles!
🎢 Bar Swing across big gaps!
💨 Slide & Climb to stay fast!

❤️ LIKE, FAVORITE, AND JOIN OUR GROUP FOR 1 FREE CHECKPOINT AND UPDATES!
